data.name: Sangey
data.long_meaning: Sangey is a name of Sanskrit and Hindi origin, derived from the words 'san' meaning joy and 'gey' meaning melodious. It reflects the idea of a joyful and melodious being. In Hinduism, it is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sangey is a name that resonates with the joy and creativity of the divine. It is believed to bring happiness and harmony to the bearer's life, and to inspire a love of music and the arts. In Hinduism, it is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who embodies the wisdom and knowledge that underlie all creative endeavors.
